mapper.select: SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(u.created_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(u.created_at) DAY) AS statWeek, COUNT(*) AS signupCount, SUM(u.member_type = 'STUDENT') AS studentCount, SUM(u.member_type = 'ALUMNI') AS alumniCount FROM users u WHERE u.created_at >= #{fromWeekStart} GROUP BY statWeek
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stats_signup_weekly (stat_week, signup_count, student_count, alumni_count, captured_at) VALUES
(#{r.statWeek}, #{r.signupCount}, #{r.studentCount}, #{r.alumniCount}, NOW())
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE signup_count = new.signup_count, student_count = new.student_count, alumni_count = new.alumni_count, captured_at = new.captured_at
